name: actual-budget
description: Ask your Actual Budget where the money went, and let it write back safely: every delete previews first and asks before it destroys anything.

settings.name: Actual server URL
settings.description: Where your Actual Budget server is reachable, for example http://localhost:5006

settings.name: Server password
settings.description: The password for your Actual server. Leave empty if your server uses OIDC and you set a session token instead.

settings.name: Budget Sync ID
settings.description: Actual shows this under Settings > Show advanced settings. It is the Sync ID, not the Budget ID shown above it — the two look alike and only the Sync ID works.

settings.name: Session token (OIDC servers only)
settings.description: For servers behind OIDC, which have no password. Use this instead of the password; if both are set, the token wins.

settings.name: Read-only mode
settings.description: Set to 1 to expose only the read and analysis tools. The write tools are not registered at all, so they never reach tool discovery.
